Definition: from G5172; luxurious; Tryphæna, a Christian woman:--Tryphena.
BiblicalUsage: Tryphena was a Christian woman in Rome whom Paul greets as one who labours in the Lord. She is named beside Tryphosa, and the two are remembered together for their work. Nothing more is said of her, but Paul's greeting is itself her commendation.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Lord sees labour no one else records, and Paul's greeting is proof of it. Tryphena's name is kept because her work was real.
